card.name: Linking words before blood pressure changes
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "in" after "can result", or "and" and "Significant", right before a blood pressure effect like hypotension or elevated pressure. Seen in warnings about drug combinations.

modes.label: result in
modes.description: The word "in" after "can result" in an interaction warning, just before hypotension or lowered pressure.
modes.example: WARNINGS Amplification of the vasodilatory effects of nitroglycerin by sildenafil can result<< in>> severe hypotension.

modes.label: Other linking words
modes.description: A word like "Significant", "of" or "and" that comes just before a high or low blood pressure term.
modes.example: 5.8 Increase in Blood Pressure<< Significant>> elevation in blood pressure, including hypertensive

card.writes: It suppresses "low" and "high" words, so it seems to hold back those words where a blood pressure term is expected next.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a warning about blood pressure going too low or too high.
